query: How long does IT take to install software I requested?

prompt.system:

Rules:
1. Answer ONLY from the chunks provided below. Do not use outside knowledge.
2. Cite every claim with the chunk_id it comes from, in square brackets, e.g. [hr-leave-policy-v2::s03p0]. Use only chunk_ids that appear below.

prompt.user:
Chunks:

[it-software-install-v2::s03p0]
Once a request has been approved, IT installs the software or adds it to the
catalogue within **3 business days**. Requests that need a new paid licence
may take longer if procurement is required; the employee is told the expected
date when the request is approved.

[it-new-joiner-setup-guide::s10p0]
Standard software is installed during first login. Other approved software can
be installed at any time from the self-service software catalogue; see How to
Install Software from the Catalogue. For anything not in the catalogue, the
request process and fulfilment time are set in the Software Installation
Policy.

Never install software from outside the catalogue without approval, and never
install tools on the prohibited list in that policy.

[it-software-catalogue-howto::s00p0]
The self-service software catalogue lets you install approved applications
on your company laptop without raising a ticket. This page explains how to
use it. Which software is allowed, how to request software that is not in the
catalogue, and how long IT takes to fulfil a request are all covered by the
Software Installation Policy.

[it-troubleshooting-faq::s15p0]
Raise a software request through the IT service portal. The approval steps and
the time IT takes to install approved software are set out in the Software
Installation Policy.

[it-software-catalogue-howto::s02p0]
1. Search for the application by name, or browse by category.
2. Select it and read the short description.
3. Click *Install*. Installation happens in the background, and you can keep
   working.
4. Some applications need a restart. The catalogue will tell you, and you can
   choose when to restart.

Question: How long does IT take to install software I requested?

Answer (cite every claim as [chunk_id]):

response: According to [it-software-install-v2::s03p0], once a request has been approved, IT installs the software or adds it to the catalogue within **3 business days**. Additionally, [it-new-joiner-setup-guide::s10p0] mentions that the request process and fulfilment time are set in the Software Installation Policy.
